_meta.title: Nepali word list — Praise to the Twenty-One Tārās (general grade)
_meta.choices: Devanagari · standard Nepali with the Sanskrit Buddhist vocabulary and the forms familiar in Nepal's Tibetan Buddhist communities (general grade) · mantra syllables in Devanagari · flagged picks decided by Claude, with the reason written down (Tenkal, 2026-09-25).
_meta.decided_by: Claude pick — user delegated flagged picks ("you do it"), 2026-09-25
_meta.sources_note: (1) the standard Sanskrit Buddhist term in Nepali spelling (शान्ति, मन्त्र, आनन्द — Nepali keeps the Sanskrit nasal consonants); (2) the checked Hindi word list and Hindi draft 5 (source code `related`: same script, same Sanskrit vocabulary — a guide, not a copy, since Nepali grammar and several everyday words differ); (3) the Gemini zero-shot ne draft (Gemini/ne/, 2026-09-17), a suggestion only; (4) the mantra recitation form.

source_labels.related: Hindi word list and Hindi draft 5

_meta.baseline: the Gemini zero-shot draft (Gemini/ne/, 2026-09-17) already uses 126 of 136 locked words (93%, check_termbase_consistency.py --lang ne) before any priming. Misses: joy (प्रमुदित throughout), जलजात for कमल at 1-8, त्रत् for त्रट्, I-2 प्रणाम, 1-19 समूह, 2-1 युक्त. It also has the 1-1 'lotus face' error and 'तुत्तार' for तुत्तारे.

homage.note: Flagged. The Hindi lock is नमस्कार, but in Nepali नमस्कार is the everyday greeting; वन्दना is the devotional word and the zero-shot draft already uses it for every refrain (वन्दना उनलाई). I-2 had प्रणाम in the draft.

tara.note: the Sanskrit name; also the Hindi lock.

benefits.note: as Hindi; the draft has लाभसहित (I-2) and लाभ (2-0).

noble_venerable.note: Flagged. भट्टारिका is the Sanskrit equivalent of རྗེ་བཙུན་མ (the venerable lady), and Nepal's Buddhists know it from the Sanskrit liturgy (आर्यतारा भट्टारिका); the draft chose it on its own. Kept apart from भगवती (བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་མ), as in Hindi. The plainer alternative is पूज्य आर्या (the Hindi lock).

sanskrit_title.ne: नमः तारा एकविंशति स्तोत्र गुणहित साक
sanskrit_title.note: the Sanskrit title in Devanagari, as in Hindi; the draft matches.

praise.note: as Hindi; consistent in the draft.

blessed_tara.note: a-1; Bhagavatī is the Sanskrit of བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་མ.

perfectly.note: the natural Nepali adverb (Hindi पूर्णतः); the draft uses it in 1-15 and 1-21.

perfect_buddha.note: Samyaksambuddha, written as one word as in the draft (Hindi सम्यक् सम्बुद्ध).

lightning.note: Flagged. Everyday Nepali for lightning (the draft's word); Hindi locked the Sanskrit विद्युत, which in Nepali reads as technical 'electricity'.

world.note: as Hindi; consistent in the draft (त्रिलोक, सप्तलोक).

face.note: as Hindi; also covers the draft's मुखमण्डल.

lotus.note: as Hindi. The draft's जलजात ('water-born') at 1-8 is to be replaced by the lock.

lotus_face.note: 1-8 only, her own lotus face. In 1-1 the lotus grows from the Lord's face (consensus); the draft's कमल-मुखको there is the same error the other languages had.

light.note: as Hindi; consistent in the draft.

blaze.note: as Hindi; the draft uses it in 1-2, 1-12, 1-13.

moon.note: the stem, as in Hindi (covers चन्द्रमा, अर्धचन्द्र). At 1-18 the draft wrote मृगाङ्क (चन्द्रमा) — the parenthesis is an addition.

peace.note: Nepali spelling of the Sanskrit (Hindi writes शांति).

without_exception.note: as Hindi; the draft uses it in 1-4 and 1-8.

hum.note: the seed syllable as chanted. The draft puts syllables in quotation marks ('हूँ'); the style asks for none.

syllable.note: the generic word; the draft's word.

trampling.note: Flagged. The stem of the native Nepali verb 'to trample' (कुल्चेर, कुल्चँदै in the draft); Hindi's आक्रांत is literary in Nepali. Locked as the stem so every verb form matches.

feet.note: the respectful word, as Hindi; consistent in the draft.

tuttare.note: as chanted (ॐ तारे तुत्तारे तुरे स्वाहा). The draft wrote 'तुत्तार' — wrong ending.

hosts.note: as Hindi; consistent in the draft.

destroy.note: the Nepali verb नष्ट गर्नु, consistent in the draft (Hindi विनाश).

great.note: the stem, as Hindi (महान्, महाभयङ्करी, महिमा…).

supreme.note: as Hindi, kept apart from 'great'. The draft had अत्यन्त ('very') at 1-10.

power.note: as Hindi; the draft's वशीभूत contains it.

joy.note: Flagged. The noun, in Nepali spelling (Hindi आनंद); आनन्दित/आनन्दमय also match. The draft uses प्रमुदित throughout, so the primed run and enforcement must change 1-10, 1-13, 1-16, 1-19.

syllable_hum.note: built from the hum + syllable locks, as the English does ('the syllable hum'); the draft's form. (Hindi split अक्षर / हूँ बीजाक्षर; Nepali keeps one word for ཡི་གེ.)

perfectly_endowed.note: perfectly + endowed; the draft's form in 1-15 and 1-21.

endowed.note: as Hindi. At 2-1 the draft paraphrased (भक्तिभाव राख्ने).

mantra.note: Nepali spelling (Hindi मंत्र); the draft matches.

demon.note: Flagged, as in Hindi: ग्रह in the sense of an afflicting spirit (ग्रहदशा, ग्रह लाग्नु are everyday Nepali). The draft chose it too.

tara_syllable.note: Nepali-only entry. The recitation form, as Hindi/Chinese/Vietnamese; the draft wrote 'तारा', which reads as her name.
